channel.title: Winston and Saffron
channel.description: Winston (a grumpy blue gorilla) and Saffron (a fairy librarian) co-host a show about the things their executive producer Luke is into: deep-dives on MCDM's survival-horror dungeon crawler Crows: Fortune or Death, and Mostly Correct, a weekly quiz show built from the week's news, grammar lessons, and Luke's life. Episodes are hosted on the Internet Archive; this feed is the show's own.
channel.itunes:author: Winston and Saffron

item.title: The Road
item.description: Winston and Saffron deep-dive the road in MCDM's Crows: Fortune or Death (Public Playtest 3) — the travel procedure, two encounter checks per travel day plus one during rest, travel pace, travel roles, and why a high encounter number now raises the chance of an encounter. Episode 3 of the Oct 28–Nov 1 Crows mini-series for Luke's first run. Music: "Feral Chase" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

item.title: The Village
item.description: Winston and Saffron deep-dive the village phase in MCDM's Crows: Fortune or Death (Public Playtest 3) — the 20-day village cycle, Prosperity, institutions, crafting, healing, and why downtime is what makes the next delve survivable. Episode 2 of the Oct 28–Nov 1 Crows mini-series for Luke's first run. Music: "Feral Chase" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

item.title: Making a Crow
item.description: Winston and Saffron deep-dive character creation in MCDM's Crows: Fortune or Death (Public Playtest 3) — backgrounds, characteristics, binary expertises, the shared Effort pool (max 2 at 1st level), and Complexity for crafting. Episode 1 of the Oct 28–Nov 1 Crows mini-series for Luke's first run. Music: "Feral Chase" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

item.title: Crows: Fortune or Death — An Overview
item.description: Winston and Saffron give a full overview of MCDM's survival-horror dungeon crawler Crows: Fortune or Death — the fortune-or-death bargain, the village-travel-dungeon loop, Playtest Three rules, the dungeons, and played impressions from executive producer Luke ahead of his first run on November first. This is the bumpered edition, with the show's theme bumper. Music: "Feral Chase" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

item.title: Winston and Saffron: The Handover
item.description: The first episode. Winston — deep-voiced, gruff, and mildly put-upon — meets his co-host Saffron, and the two of them work out, live on air, how this show is going to go. Executive producer: Luke.
